divisions.title: Ruth & Naomi
divisions.summary: A Moabite widow clings to Naomi and gleans in the field of Boaz

divisions.title: Ruth & Boaz
divisions.summary: At the threshing floor and the gate, Ruth is redeemed and becomes David's great-grandmother

chapterSummaries.1: Famine drives Naomi to Moab; Ruth clings to her on the road back to Bethlehem
chapterSummaries.2: Ruth gleans in the field of Boaz; he shows her favor
chapterSummaries.3: At midnight on the threshing floor, Ruth asks Boaz to redeem her
chapterSummaries.4: The nearer kinsman declines; Boaz redeems Ruth; Obed born in the line to David
